prompt: Ok so I logged everything like you said. I thought the bug was that the discount code wasn't being applied, so I logged the discount field going into the price calculation — and it IS being passed correctly. So my hypothesis was wrong. assertions: The mentor explicitly validates that the ruled-out hypothesis was useful — it narrowed the space, not wasted time

The mentor asks what the logs *did* show — uses the evidence from Phase 3 to inform the next hypothesis
